podcasts.name: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Suicide by Hanging (1999)
podcast.body: Screamin' Lord Such died on June 16, 1999, by suicide, having suffered from manic depression for many years. "He died on June 16, 1999 when he committed suicide by hanging. He'd suffered from manic depression for many years."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Deliberate Provocation
podcast.body: His primary stage strategy was to provoke the British public with his over-the-top antics, eliciting the precise response he intended. "His old stick was to bait the British people with his over the top antics and they responded just how he'd hoped."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Jack the Ripper Persona
podcast.body: When performing live, he often dressed as Jack the Ripper, emerging from a coffin with knives, daggers, skulls, and fake bodies as part of his "shock horror" act. "When he performed live, he often dressed as Jack the Ripper, rising out of a coffin with his knives, daggers and skulls and fake bodies, so shock horror."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Political Activism
podcast.body: Screamin' Lord Such founded the Official Monster Raving Looney Party and ran for British Parliament at least 40 times between 1963 and 1997, which many in Britain found offensive. "Such was the founder of the official Monster Raving Looney Party and ran for British Parliament at least 40 times between 1963 and 1997 and that alone was offensive to many in Britain."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
